hero.prompt: A painterly editorial illustration of a quiet twilight English midland landscape under a vast water-toned sky. Low rolling fields and a still distant horizon sit beneath a sky where cool Cancer silver-blue light, protective and emotionally intense like still deep water, washes over most of the scene, while a warm Jupiter amber-gold glow rests low on one side of the horizon, as if a benevolent planet is briefly visiting. Palette of deep indigo fading to near-black (#16112c to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), and a teal-and-gold nebula wash drifting across the upper sky. Intense, contemplative, full-bleed wide 16:9 atmosphere that fills the frame. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
